blocks.text: Why estate planners rely on Excel

Estate planning involves managing diverse asset classes. You track real estate, investment accounts, and personal property. Excel remains the standard for these calculations because it offers flexibility that dedicated legal software sometimes lacks. On a Mac, Microsoft 365 provides the power you need to perform complex valuations.
Essential Excel shortcuts for Mac users

Large datasets often lead to errors. Use data validation to restrict input types. This keeps your asset lists clean. If you are comparing two columns, use the VLOOKUP or XLOOKUP function. These tools identify discrepancies between bank statements and client reports quickly.
If you struggle to find a specific feature in the ribbon, hold Option + Command to ask Lazur where it is. Lazur will draw a circle around the button for you.
blocks.title: Find tools faster

blocks.text: Excel often strips leading zeros from account numbers. To fix this, set the cell format to Text before you paste your data. Go to the Home tab, click the number format dropdown, and select Text. This ensures your account IDs remain accurate.
How to stay productive with Lazur

Lazur works in the background while you focus on the numbers. You can ask it to explain a complex formula or guide you through creating a pivot table. It does not touch your files. It only watches your screen to provide helpful, accurate guidance.
